objective: test whether original entry information and realized D1/D3/D5 path add stable conditional information beyond recomputing the frozen five-block entry contract at the current close

folds.fold_role: owner-authorized repeatedly reused recent decision folds, not a pristine holdout
folds.date_weighting: each current decision date contributes equally

landmarks.exclusion_reason: D1 exclusions are structural duplicates or constants: entry return equals close MFE and last return, close MAE equals peak drawdown, mean turnover equals last turnover, and one-day volatility/tradable fraction are constant for filled entries

population.entry_rows: every OOS row with a complete frozen entry contract and an actually filled original next-open entry
population.current_candidate_absence: retain and report separately; never silently remove from cohort accounting
population.primary_common_support: holding target is valid and the frozen current entry contract is available

primary.mfe_10: maximum legal sellable close return from D1 through D10 relative to the next-open anchor; not floored at zero
primary.mfe_20: maximum legal sellable close return from D1 through D20 relative to the next-open anchor; not floored at zero
primary.state_10: through-2022 fixed-K3 D1-D10 close-path state relative to the next-open anchor
primary.pre_peak_mae_10: minimum of zero and D1-to-best-holding-MFE close returns
primary.pre_peak_mae_20: minimum of zero and D1-to-best-holding-MFE close returns

matched_entry_diagnostic.mfe_10: maximum legal sellable close return from D2 through D10 relative to the same next-open anchor
matched_entry_diagnostic.mfe_20: maximum legal sellable close return from D2 through D20 relative to the same next-open anchor
matched_entry_diagnostic.pre_peak_mae_10: minimum of zero and D1-to-best matched-entry MFE close returns through D10
matched_entry_diagnostic.pre_peak_mae_20: minimum of zero and D1-to-best matched-entry MFE close returns through D20

evaluation.conditional_statistic: daily partial Spearman after residualizing both added coordinate and forward target on the current six-degree contract projection
incremental_metrics: Newey-West HAC standard error and p-value
within-current-contract residual top-minus-bottom auxiliary quintile target spread
